attrs.gap: Fable wrote that the provenance DAG is the carrier the support function is read off. GPT-5.6 rejected that and R6 implements the rejection as a refusal rather than a caution: `provenance` is a declared support-evidence kind whose declared effect is that the engine refuses to compute anything from it. Lineage says B descended from A. It does not say the capability still needs A — the competence may have been copied into weights, recompiled elsewhere, or independently rediscovered while the edge survived. The stakes are why this is a refusal and not a note: a revocation cut is a plan to destroy artifacts, and computing one from lineage is an irreversible act taken on evidence that does not reach the claim. OPEN because the refusal is implemented and nothing has yet passed it.
attrs.implementation_binding: scripts/emb-support.mjs — the CAUSAL filter in §1, against mosaic/embodiment.json support_evidence_kinds
attrs.statement: Every artifact-support set used to compute a continuity kernel or a revocation cut is backed by causal evidence — ablation, intervention, runtime dependency or replacement replay — and never by lineage alone.
